summary: Phase 56 Platform Manager (institution detail console + school admin password reset + login-email change + public reset page + dashboard/list) end-to-end verified. Backend pytest tests/test_phase56_platform.py: 5/5 pass (non-platform 403 on all 10 endpoints + unauth 401; summary with 7 stats and 30-day trend; institutions-list, overview, analytics with Not-tracked AI tokens/storage, admins; plan update + audit entry + visible under Activity; password-reset returns real Resend message id, saves token_hash only, invalidates earlier link, token success revokes old sessions, reuse → 410 'already been used', expired → 410 'expired', garbage → 410; change-email 409 on existing, 422 on invalid, 404 cross-institution, 200 case-insensitive save with two Resend message ids, old login 401 + new login 200, audit entry). Frontend verified at 1440 + 390: platform login works; /platform/dashboard shows 7 stat-* cards with real numbers (schools 7, active 5, students 65, teachers 116, active_users_7d 50, open_issues 4, messages_month 91) + 30-day sign-ins trend; /platform/institutions shows inst-search, plan/status filters, 6 sortable headers (sort-*), 7 rows, New institution button. /platform/institutions/<iid> loads for Sunrise + TEST (Fees Demo) + throwaway with header (logo, name, code, plan badge, status pill, qa-admins/qa-plan/qa-open-login) and all 8 tabs (overview/analytics/plan/admins/domain/branding/features/activity) selectable via inst-tab-<key> with ?tab=<key> persisting in URL. On the throwaway school (not LPGS): Edit plan → edit-plan-dialog → plan-save-btn → plan-confirm-dialog → plan-confirm-btn flow saves and the audit entry is visible on the Activity tab. Admins tab: admin-reset-<id> → reset-dialog → reset-send-btn flow is wired correctly — the live POST during this UI run returned 502 because the backend's Resend provider was rate-limited (ERROR 'email rate limit exceeded', code=rate_limited) from the preceding pytest burst; the UI correctly surfaces the real Cloudflare/provider error instead of faking success (matches 'must never fake success' requirement). admin-email-btn-<id> → email-dialog → new-email-input → email-save-btn correctly shows email-error 'That email is already used by another account' on 409 with admin@sunrise-demo.in. Public /reset-password/<token>: school-branded card (P56 Throwaway), masked email, 2 password inputs with eye toggles, 5 strength rules (8+ chars, Upper, Lower, Number, match), POST success → 'Password updated' + 'Go to sign in'; reusing the same token shows reset-invalid 'This reset link has already been used.'; garbage token shows reset-invalid 'This reset link is no longer valid.' Non-platform (admin@sunrise-demo.in) → 403 on /platform/summary, /platform/institutions-list, /platform/institutions/{iid}/overview; unauth → 401. All 10 Phase 56 endpoints are listed in /api/openapi.json. No new React console warnings (the previously fixed Select hydration warning did not reappear).

minor.issue: Resend 'rate_limited' errors (code=rate_limited) occur when pytest burst-sends many emails just before UI testing; backend correctly returns 502 and does not fake success. Consider adding a short exponential backoff + friendlier UI retry copy ('Email provider is throttling us, try again in a moment') to improve demo UX.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py remains >13k lines; Phase 56 adds another sizeable block (platform console + reset flows). The modularisation suggestion from iterations 39/40 still stands: split platform_* / password_reset / email_change into dedicated routers.

Password reset UI surfaces the raw Cloudflare 502 'origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response' message when the backend returns 502 after a Resend rate-limit; while technically correct (no fake success), it would read better as 'Email provider is temporarily unavailable, please retry in a moment' from the frontend side.
